actions.name: create.new_session
actions.says: Open a Create session: a vertical and a name, which are also the library folders what it saves goes in (<vertical>/<name>). A name already used in that vertical opens that session again.

args.name: name
args.says: the session's name, as the team would call it; it becomes a folder, so no / or \

args.name: vertical_id
args.says: the vertical's id, from library.verticals or shared/verticals

args.name: vertical_name
args.says: the vertical's name, from the same list

actions.name: create.send
actions.says: Send a turn in a session: Create makes pictures with OpenAI and writes headlines (always in English) from the prompt and the picked items. Picked pictures are changed as the prompt says (or varied, with no prompt); picked headlines are varied. Pick items with create.items.

args.name: prompt
args.says: what to make or change, in the person's words

args.name: picked
args.says: ids of the session's items to start from (create.items), in order; empty for none

args.name: images
args.says: how many pictures to make, 0 to 8

args.name: headlines
args.says: how many headlines to write, 0 to 20; not both 0

actions.costs: Paid to OpenAI: each picture, and one text call for the headlines. A session's cost_usd says what it spent; OpenAI credit is short, so ask for no more pictures than the person needs.

actions.name: create.save_items
actions.says: Save chosen items of a session into the library, in the session's own folder (made by its first save), which Launch then makes ads from. Every item must be the session's and done.

args.name: ai_label
args.says: the person's answer for the pictures: marked as made by AI (ai, as Create's page does by default), not_ai, or unset. Ask the person when they have not said

actions.returns: the save's id; create.saves shows the library_set_id once it is saved

actions.name: create.sessions
actions.says: Create's sessions: each one's vertical and name (its library folder), the library set once something was saved, and what it cost.

actions.name: create.turns
actions.says: The turns sent in sessions: the prompt, the items picked, how many pictures and headlines were asked, and whether it is making, done or failed (error says why).

actions.name: create.items
actions.says: The pictures (kind image; image_url once done) and headlines (kind headline, text) of sessions, where each came from (origin, the turn and the items it started from), and the library's id once saved.

actions.name: create.saves
actions.says: Saves of session items into the library: waiting, saving, done or failed, and the library set (Launch opens it at /launch/new?set=<library_set_id>).
